Assam Government's Anti-Drug Efforts and Aadhaar Card Policy Debates

The Assam Chief Minister, Himanta Biswa Sarma, stated that his government is actively combating drug abuse to protect the state's youth. Concurrently, there is an ongoing discussion regarding the Assam government's potential policy to stop Aadhaar cards for all residents above 18 years of age. Experts hold differing opinions on the feasibility and implications of such a move. These two issues highlight the government's focus on social welfare and administrative policies.
